title: The debarment-report firm and the certified firms around it
question: Which certified local firms are tied to a firm on the debarment reports, and where do their other ties lead?
finding: 4 directory firms are on, or linked to a firm on, the City's debarment reports. AZUL WORKS INC is itself listed (agreement not to do business with the city pending criminal case and stipulated stay of debarment proceedings, reports to 2025-06-30) and its certification runs to 2028-10-31; it appears in 9 published screens elsewhere. Terocons Inc., a recorded affiliate of the listed firm, also names SIERRA MOUNTAIN CONSTRUCTION INC as an affiliate (paid $106.9 million since fiscal 2019).
how: Rows of lbe_fronts "certified local firms on, or beside a firm on, the debarment reports" were extended with each firm's other recorded affiliates (lbe-restricted-affiliates-paid) and its shared-address sets (lbe-shared-identifiers), and every name was looked up in the published rows of all other screens.
limits: An agreement not to do business pending a criminal case is not a debarment, and certification and debarment are decided by different offices. Shared addresses are common for small firms sharing a yard or a bookkeeper. Name and address matches only.
